facts.business: Hira Automobiles Limited is an authorized dealer of Maruti Suzuki India Limited for sale of vehicles, spare parts, and servicing.

auditor.name: M/s. Mohan Juneja and Associates, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: One lender classified borrowing facility (~₹10 crore) as SMA-2 as at 31 March 2026 and subsequently as NPA; Maruti Suzuki temporarily suspended vehicle supplies; matter unresolved as at report date.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to lender classifying borrowing as NPA and Maruti Suzuki suspending supplies
High dependence on single OEM (Maruti Suzuki) for vehicle supply
Concentration of revenue from sale of vehicles (~82%)
Working capital constraints and overdue borrowings
Related party transactions with entities controlled by promoters
Low public float (42.86% shares in demat, promoter holding 95.72%)
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd (vehicle purchases ₹382.45 cr, spare parts ₹28.76 cr, service income ₹1.23 cr, discount ₹12.45 cr, trade payable ₹18.76 cr); Hira Motors (rent paid ₹0.12 cr, trade payable ₹0.03 cr); Hira Autotech (rent paid ₹0.08 cr); Remuneration to KMPs (Rahulinder Singh Sidhu ₹0.48 cr, Neha Sidhu ₹0.24 cr, others); Rent to promoters (Rahulinder Singh Sidhu ₹0.36 cr, Neha Sidhu ₹0.18 cr); Loans from directors (Rahulinder Singh Sidhu ₹2.10 cr outstanding, Neha Sidhu ₹0.85 cr outstanding).
